verdict.rationale: Box exposes a full REST API with OAuth token auth, curl-able endpoints, and SDKs, which supports headless/CI automation of file operations, metadata, webhooks, and events. However, evidence is mostly generic API docs rather than CI-specific guidance (no GitHub Actions examples, no documented service-account/CI auth flow beyond developer tokens, and one SDK repo note about deprecated version support raises maintenance concerns). missing for 10: CI-specific tutorials/examples, dedicated service-account or CI auth pattern, independent hands-on CI automation reports.
